subject: Ops/Architecture sync: next steps for Private VPC deployment
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Matthew Jones <matthew.jones@acmehealth.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Ops/Architecture sync: next steps for Private VPC deployment

Hi Matthew —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap from our side so we’re aligned before scheduling the architecture workshop:

- Goal: run a 60–75 minute architecture workshop to map out Private/VPC topology, routing/egress needs, and operational handoffs so we can produce a deployment runbook and a scoped Dedicated or Private deployment quote.
- Success criteria: high-level network diagram, list of required firewall rules, expected steady-state throughput and peak concurrency, and a named SRE/ops contact for host-level troubleshooting.

Proposed next steps:
1) Schedule the workshop (see slots below).
2) Your team shares a short network diagram (or AWS account VPC IDs) and any IP allowlist constraints before the call. I attached our pre-call checklist for that.
3) Redwood will bring an SE (Aditya) and a Solutions Architect to walk topology, KV cache considerations, and access patterns.

Available slots (PST):
- Tue 16 Mar, 10:00–11:15 AM
- Wed 17 Mar, 2:00–3:15 PM
- Thu 18 Mar, 9:00–10:15 AM

Can you confirm which of the above works (or propose two alternatives)? Also please confirm attendees from your side — we generally suggest: one infra lead, one network/SecOps, and one app owner.

Pre-call attachments: redwood-precall-checklist.docx (attached) — it lists the network/permissions items we typically request. We do NOT need credentials in advance, just diagrams, CIDR ranges, and any maintenance windows.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-precall-checklist.docx (docx, 48KB)

Priya —

Thanks for the clear recap. The plan makes sense. A few constraints from our side:

- We cannot do Friday mornings due to regular maintenance windows.
- The team available for an architecture workshop is: myself (Director, infra), Rachel Lin (Network/SecOps), and the infra-team alias will loop in our SRE on-call.

Of your proposed slots, Tue 16 Mar 10:00–11:15 AM PST looks promising. Can you hold that provisional while I confirm with Rachel? If that works, we’ll send a Calendar invite and attach a one-page network diagram (VPC ranges + public/private subnets).

Two asks before the call: 1) please include a Redwood SE who can speak to PCI/HIPAA controls for the Private deployment, and 2) can you confirm whether Redwood will need to request any account-level IAM roles or just CIDR/IP allowlist upfront?

Thanks — Matt
